name: check_hardware_entitlement
description: check_hardware_entitlement: Check whether an employee is eligible for a hardware request. Returns their current device information, lifecycle status (whether the device meets the minimum age for replacement), and whether a request is already pending for this equipment category.

employee_id.description: The employee to check entitlement for (e.g. EMP048271).

request_type.description: The type of hardware being requested.
